atoms.text: Lisa: “You have no idea what happened yesterday evening. I was on my way home, when I surprisingly saw an old friend from primary school. We talked and he excitedly told me that his cousin goes to our school too. What a coincidence! Before we said goodbye, we agreed to meet each other again next Friday.”
